clips.title: The story
paras: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is a Darkspear troll mystic dwelling in a cave at Malaka'jin in the southern Stonetalon Mountains. A longtime comrade of Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan, he turns dark voodoo and ritual sorcery against the Horde's local enemies.

Secluded inside an eastern cavern above the camp of Malaka'jin, Jin'Zil practices ancient jungle troll arts away from the coastal home of his tribe. Surrounded by bubbling cauldrons and captive prisoners, he gathers exotic reagents from the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains to weave potent blessings and curses in defense of the Horde's mountain encampment.

Jin'Zil is no ordinary hedge wizard; he shares a storied history with senior Horde scouts, counting both Darsok Swiftdagger and the renowned shadow hunter Rokhan among his old friends. While Darsok coordinates frontline skirmishes against night elves and harpies, Jin'Zil fights the war spiritually and alchemically, using his forest magic and volatile voodoo to undermine threats before they ever reach the camp gates.
